rootCause: Author proposals included readyForApplication inside the reviewed after object. SQL correctly persisted only actual question columns, but the post-apply verifier compared the live database with that review-only flag and failed after the SQL transaction committed.
resolution: Updated the builder to retain readiness metadata in the reviewed hash while excluding it from persisted question content, and updated the apply verifier to omit readiness metadata from live/archive comparisons. A guarded rerun matched all 32 after states and archives.
notes: The first apply command reported a post-apply content comparison failure before writing its normal application record.
The follow-up guarded run verified the committed state against all 32 proposals, confirmed complete applied revision archives, unchanged answer/exam history checksums, and idempotence.
